title: Sphynx quiz
description: A set of questions about Java. Lives in <folder>/<quiz-id>/quiz.json. Guide: docs/quizzes.md

id.description: Unique id. Defaults to the folder name (recommended: leave it out).

title.description: Name shown in the Quizzes group and at the top of the quiz.

topic.description: The unit this quiz belongs to (Basics, Conditionals, Loops, Strings, Methods, Arrays, Collections, OOP, Exceptions, Recursion or Streams); it is listed at the end of that unit. Other values or none: the quiz goes to the Custom section.

requires.description: Units the student should know first, by unit key (for example "Loops" from Java Programming). Shown with the student's progress in each unit; never enforced.

subject.description: The subject (for example "cs"), for content without a unit. Otherwise the unit decides the subject.

enumDescriptions: Multiple choice. "answer" is the index of the right option (0 = first), or a list of indexes when several are right.
True or false. "answer" is true or false.
Short answer typed by the student. "answer" is an accepted answer or a list of them.
What does this code print? "answer" is the exact output (leave it "" and run Validate → fill in expected outputs), or an option index when "options" is given.
type.description: "number": a number typed by the student, compared by value (see "base" and "tolerance").

prompt.description: The question (Markdown). Optional for "output" (defaults to "What does this code print?").

code.description: Java code shown with the question. For "output" it is compiled and run by the validator; a snippet is wrapped in void main() { … }.

options.description: Choices for "choice", or for "output" when the student picks instead of typing.

answer.description: The right answer; its form depends on "type".

base.description: For "number" questions: the base the answer is written in. Students may type prefixes (0b, 0o, 0x), spaces and leading zeros.

tolerance.description: For "number" questions in base 10: how far the student's answer may be from "answer" (for decimals, e.g. 0.01).

explanation.description: Shown after a practice check (Markdown). Never shown during an exam.

points.description: Points for this question (all or nothing).

translations.description: Translations, by language (for example "pt-br"). Answers stay the same; for short answers you can add accepted answers in the other language.

questions.description: One entry per question, in the same order.

options.description: For "choice" questions: the options in the same order. Options of "output" questions are program output and are never translated.

answer.description: For "short" questions: extra accepted answers in this language.
